title: Culturing THP-1 Cells
author: Teesha C Luehr
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.y6gfzbw
materials: Reguired supplements: 1 % volume, L-glutamine 10 % volume, Fetal Bovine Serum Most catalog numbers of RMPI-1640 contain L-glutamine, however, some do not. Ensure that it is in the media before using it for culturing.

steps.title: Prepare complete RPMI-1640 medium
steps.instruction: Use RPMI‑1640 as base medium and optionally add 1 % (v/v) supplement, PenStrep to 0.05 mM (or 1 X if contamination is a concern), and 2‑mercaptoethanol only if desired; note that 2‑mercaptoethanol is not routinely used in our lab.

steps.title: Warm complete medium
steps.instruction: Place the complete medium bottle in a 37 °C water bath for at least 30 minutes before use.

steps.title: Thaw cryovial
steps.instruction: Thaw the frozen THP‑1 cell vial at room temperature (25 °C) for 10 minutes or in a 37 °C water bath for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Transfer thawed cells
steps.instruction: Immediately after thawing, transfer the cell suspension to a 15 mL conical tube and add 10 mL of the pre‑warmed complete medium (cells contain 5 % DMSO, which can lyse cells if left too long).

steps.title: Pellet cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube at 500 g for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Resuspend cell pellet
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet by pipetting up and down five times in 5 mL of complete medium.

steps.title: Sanitize BSC items
steps.instruction: Wipe all items that will enter the Biological Safety Cabinet with 70 % ethanol.

steps.title: Seed cells in T‑25
steps.instruction: Transfer the cell suspension (cells + media) into a T‑25 flask.

steps.title: Incubate culture
steps.instruction: Place the T‑25 flask in a 37 °C incubator set to 5 % CO₂ and 80 % humidity.

steps.title: Monitor growth
steps.instruction: Observe the culture; when cells have roughly doubled (≈2 days) or the medium changes colour, proceed to passage or media change.

steps.title: Optional cell count
steps.instruction: If precise cell concentration is needed, perform a cell count.

steps.title: Refresh medium / split
steps.instruction: Add new complete medium to double the total volume in the flask and mix gently by rocking the flask back and forth.

steps.title: Scale up to T‑175
steps.instruction: When the T‑25 flask reaches its volume limit, transfer all cell‑media from the T‑25 to a T‑175 flask using a 10 mL pipette (larger pipettes do not fit).

steps.title: Add fresh medium in T‑175
steps.instruction: Double the total volume again with new complete medium and mix by rocking.

steps.title: Rescue unhealthy cultures
steps.instruction: If cells appear unhealthy, discard all existing medium and dead cells, then replenish with fresh complete medium.

steps.title: Transfer to conical tubes
steps.instruction: Move all cell‑media into 50 mL conical tubes.

steps.title: Pellet cells again
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tubes at 500 g for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Resuspend after second spin
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet by pipetting up and down five times in new complete medium; keep the same volume as before unless the cell concentration is drastically low.

steps.title: Seed into new flask
steps.instruction: Transfer the resuspended cells to a fresh T‑flask.

steps.title: Incubate new culture
steps.instruction: Place the new flask back into the 37 °C, 5 % CO₂, 80 % humidity incubator.
